question: Ground-truth the name-derived DAF classification on Foundant Giving Hubs: for the 11 hubs coded P (only 'X Advised Fund' names, 424 funds across all hubs incl. 30 at CFMT, 10 at Denver, 9 at NHCF) and a 40-fund sample of hubs coded N, match fund names against each CF's own fund directory, annual report fund list or Form 990 Schedule D narrative to settle DAF vs nonprofit-advised vs other
conclusion_affected: Share of public Foundant hubs listing DAFs (61.2% explicit; 64.9% incl. 'advised' names); whether the 105 N hubs are truly DAF-free
rationale: No hub shows a fund-type field (0 of 299), so the DAF flag rests on fund names and descriptions. Explicit wording is precise in a 40-fund hand check, but 'Advised Fund' names are ambiguous (Denver's are mostly nonprofit-advised) and N hubs may list DAFs under plain family names

question: CF policy on third-party gifts to DAFs: for 20 Foundant CFs (10 whose hub lists explicit DAFs, 10 whose hub lists none, matched on hub size), read the public DAF fund agreement, gift acceptance policy or DAF FAQ and record whether third parties may add to a DAF, whether DAFs may be published on the hub, and any minimum or fee
conclusion_affected: Whether 'public giving page for a DAF' is a vendor default that CFs switch on or off by policy (Triangle refuses; 183 of 299 hubs list at least one)
rationale: Hub listing is a CF choice per fund (Foundant PF-19). Explicit-DAF hubs are concentrated among larger hubs (Q4 by fund count: 68 of 77 vs Q1: 13 of 74), and CFMT alone publishes 585 explicit DAFs; the policy text would explain the split

question: Foundant vendor documentation for Giving Hub fund visibility: read Foundant's public help/blog pages (robots permitting) for the per-fund 'show on Giving Hub' setting, its default by fund type, and the show_granttype/show_servicearea options seen in hub markup
conclusion_affected: Why fund type is never displayed (0 of 299 hubs) though the hub template carries show_granttype; whether DAF listing is opt-in or opt-out
rationale: Two of the 12 core hubs set show_granttype=1 in the search widget but the card slot is empty on every list page read; the setting's meaning is not public in repo sources

question: DAFpay / DAF Direct on community foundation donate pages: extend the scan from homepages and give pages to each Foundant CF's 'ways to give' page and check for Chariot DAFpay or DAF Direct widgets, recording which CFs accept DAF-to-CF grants by widget
conclusion_affected: Inbound DAF-to-CF rails at CFs; whether CFs adopt the same widgets as nonprofits
rationale: 0 of 299 hubs embed DAFpay or DAF Direct; only 2 of 403 CF start pages read do (Ocean Reef: DAF Direct; CF of NCW: DAFpay). Hub text instead routes DAF gifts by mail or portal (TTCF, OICF, Shenandoah)

question: Repeat the Foundant Giving Hub census in May 2027 with the same script and a fresh cache and diff public fund counts and explicit-DAF listings per hub to measure churn and any vendor-side change to hub templates
conclusion_affected: Stability of the 61% hub share and the 94,332-fund public denominator
rationale: The census is a single-day snapshot (2026-11-20); hub templates were redesigned recently ('Welcome to your new Giving Hub!' banner at Atlanta)

question: Resolve the 101 Foundant CFs where no hub was read: 64 with no hub link on homepage or give pages, 32 whose start pages could not be read, 5 unreachable robots; use the repo's other CF URLs (990 website field, rails CSV source URLs) as alternative start pages, without guessing hub paths
conclusion_affected: Coverage of the hub-share estimate (299 of 403 unique CF hosts read)
rationale: The method follows links only; homepages behind bot protection (403) or with JS menus hide hub links. Missing CFs may differ systematically (smaller, older sites)
